items.title: No Man’s Sky Hits 10 Years with Record Players, as Hello Games Teases ‘COSMOS’ Update and Light No Fire Next
items.description: Today, UK independent developer Hello Games celebrates the tenth anniversary of No Man's Sky, by far its biggest and most popular title. For the occasion, studio founder and managing director Sean Murray shared a lengthy letter with the community, reminiscing about everything that happened throughou
items.tldr: No Man's Skyが10周年を迎え、Hello Gamesは記録的なプレイヤー数を達成し、次の「COSMOS」アップデートと「Light No Fire Next」を予告しました。

items.title: Microsoft Executive Says Windows 11 Isn’t Taking Liquid Glass’ Transparency Slider Route; Doesn’t Deny A Future Release Either, But Under Certain Conditions
items.description: Apple’s Liquid Glass UI could be the next aesthetic change to copy, particularly that transparency slider, but Microsoft doesn’t wish to adopt this approach. According to an executive, Windows 11 won’t offer additional options for users to tweak the appearance of the operating system with customizat
items.tldr: Microsoftの幹部は、Windows 11がAppleのLiquid Glass UIの透明度スライダーを採用しないと明言したが、将来的に条件次第でその可能性を否定はしなかった。

items.title: AI data center bans surge past 500 nationwide as local US politicians begin blocking new developments — growing public outrage and bipartisan pushback threaten big tech expansion plans
items.description: New AI data center development bans jumped to over 500 in July, according to recent analysis, with political and public pressure growing.
items.tldr: AIデータセンターの新規開発禁止が全国で500件を超え、政治的および公的な圧力が高まっている。

items.title: Hyperscalers commit nearly $2 trillion to secure AI hardware and memory — Google leads $811 billion spending surge while Apple trails at $57 billion
items.description: As hyperscalers increase their long-term purchase commitments, the high-tech industry faces a tectonic shift as CSPs overwhelm consumer electronics companies.
items.tldr: ハイパースケーラーがAIハードウェアとメモリに約2兆ドルを投資し、Googleが8110億ドルの支出増加を主導する一方、Appleは570億ドルに留まっている。

items.title: GeForce NOW exploit lets you access the full Windows desktop through a simple file swap — Modder runs local AI models on Ultimate tier with 48GB of VRAM and no restrictions
items.description: Swapping the executable of a game with a modified file will fool Steam into thinking it's opening that game when it's really just giving you unrestricted desktop access. This is against GeForce NOW's terms of service, though, so you run the risk of getting banned.
items.tldr: GeForce NOWのエクスプロイトを利用することで、ゲームの実行ファイルを改変し、Steamを欺いてフルWindowsデスクトップにアクセスできるが、これはサービス利用規約に違反し、アカウント停止のリスクがある。

items.title: Steam hardware distributor hit by cyberattack, 'expect fake messages,' Valve warns — Europe vendor has personal information and hardware purchase details stolen
items.description: Steam hardware customers in Europe should 'expect fake messages' said Valve in an email bulletin, after a distributor's security was breached.
items.tldr: Steamハードウェアのヨーロッパの顧客は、ディストリビューターのセキュリティ侵害により個人情報やハードウェア購入の詳細が盗まれたため、「偽のメッセージに注意するように」とValveが警告しています。

items.title: Valve Warns European Steam Hardware Buyers That Their Addresses Leaked after Shipping Partner CEVA Got Hit by a Cyberattack
items.description: Today, Valve has notified European customers via email (as first revealed on the ResetEra board) that CEVA Logistics, the third-party company responsible for shipping Steam hardware across Europe, was targeted in a cyberattack between July 29 and August 1, 2026. Valve says it learned on August 7 (la
items.tldr: Valveは、欧州のSteamハードウェア購入者に対し、配送パートナーのCEVA Logisticsがサイバー攻撃を受け、顧客の住所が漏洩したことを通知しました。攻撃は2026年7月29日から8月1日の間に発生し、Valveは8月7日にこの情報を把握しました。

items.title: Over 70% of Americans oppose AI data centers; US protests intensify as more arrests are being made — almost 40 arrested this year in backlash to AI factory buildout
items.description: The public pushback against data center construction projects is only growing stronger, even as some protesting local residents have been arrested in the process.
items.tldr: アメリカでは70%以上の人々がAIデータセンターに反対しており、抗議活動が激化する中で今年だけで約40人が逮捕されている。

items.title: CXMT’s Capacity Woes Likely Mean Its Partnership With Apple Won’t Blossom To The Same Heights As Korean Rivals; DRAM May Be Limited To Product Testing Only
items.description: Companies such as Samsung, SK hynix, and Micron have chosen to prioritize AI customers because they can place mammoth-sized DRAM orders, pushing Apple into a corner as it strategizes how to overcome this supply chain headache. While CXMT was previously reported to be a beacon of hope, the Chinese me
items.tldr: CXMTの供給能力の問題により、Appleとのパートナーシップは韓国の競合他社ほどの成功を収めない可能性が高く、DRAMは製品テストに限定される見込みです。

items.title: AMD’s Aging AM4 Platform Refuses To Die As Ryzen 5 5500 And 5800X3D Dominate Against DDR5 Costs
items.description: It's not a surprise seeing the Zen 5 X3D CPU continuing its domination in the market, but the AM4 is still alive due to two processors. Mindfactory Monthly Stats Reveal Ryzen 9800X3D is Still the Most Popular Chip, but the Revival of Ryzen 7 5800X3D Has Pushed AM4's Popularity Significantly The late
items.tldr: TL;DR: AMDのAM4プラットフォームは、Ryzen 5 5500と5800X3Dの登場により依然として人気を保っており、特にRyzen 9800X3Dが最も人気のあるチップとして君臨している。

items.title: HoverAir unveils the Versa modular pocket gimbal camera that transforms into a self-flying drone — Modular camera transforms into an auto-tracking drone by magnetically snapping together for instant palm launch and AI tracking
items.description: Have you ever wanted a pocket gimbal camera and a selfie drone that follows your around autonomously in one device? That's what the HoverAir Versa offers with a transforming, two-in-one body that can make filming yourself from all sorts of angles as convenient as possible.
items.tldr: HoverAirが発表したVersaは、ポケットサイズのジンバルカメラと自動追尾ドローンを組み合わせたモジュラーカメラで、マグネットで接続して瞬時に自動飛行が可能になる。

items.title: The only current-generation graphics card on sale below MSRP — AMD's Radeon RX 9070 GRE GPU with 12GB of VRAM returns to its lowest-ever price of $499
items.description: Grab a new GPU for less than the MSRP launch price. Gigabyte's Gaming RX 9070 GRE falls to its lowest-ever price.
items.tldr: AMDのRadeon RX 9070 GRE GPU（12GBのVRAM搭載）が、MSRPを下回る最安値の499ドルで販売中です。

items.title: Beast of Reincarnation Gets NVIDIA DLSS 4.5 and AMD FSR 4.0 Support, But Promised Story Improvements Disappoint
items.description: Beast of Reincarnation launched last week on PC, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X, and Xbox Series S, but the game's launch state was far from optimal, featuring a variety of technical issues that made it impossible for many to enjoy what is, in my opinion, a solid action RPG. GAME FREAK and Fictions im
items.tldr: 「Beast of Reincarnation」がPCやコンソール向けに発売されたが、技術的な問題が多く、プレイヤーが楽しむには不十分な状態で、NVIDIA DLSS 4.5とAMD FSR 4.0のサポートが追加されたものの、約束されたストーリー改善には失望が残る。

items.title: UK's Royal Navy sea drones contain component that secretly sent data to China, report claims — government cuts camera connectivity and insists data wasn’t sensitive, only ‘heartbeat communications’
items.description: K3 Scout surveillance drones used by the UK’s Royal Navy contain components that have been secretly transmitting data to China, according to reports.
items.tldr: 英国のロイヤルネイビーが使用するK3スカウト監視ドローンに、中国にデータを秘密裏に送信していたコンポーネントが含まれているとの報告があり、政府はカメラの接続を遮断し、送信されたデータは「ハートビート通信」のみであり、機密性はないと主張している。

items.title: Windows 11's built-in weather app hogs more than 1.2 gigabytes of RAM just to tell the forecast — memory-sucking web wrapper filled with ads masquerades as an actual application
items.description: MSN Weather acts as the native weather app for Windows 11 and all it does it run a bunch of Chromium subprocesses in the background to retrieve the forecast data. This causes it to use 5x more memory than the macOS weather app. And, oh, you also get to enjoy ads!
items.tldr: Windows 11のMSN Weatherアプリは、予報データを取得するためにChromiumのサブプロセスを多数実行し、1.2GB以上のRAMを消費しており、macOSの天気アプリの5倍のメモリを使用している上に広告も表示される。

items.title: Save nearly $350 on this 4TB Samsung 9910 Pro SSD with Gen 5 speeds right now —limited-time Woot sale delivers ultra-fast storage with speeds up to 14,800 MB/s
items.description: Save $413 on this 4TB Samsung 9100 Pro SSD, offering super-fast Gen 5 speeds, now priced at $619.99 in this limited-time Woot sale.
items.tldr: 4TBのSamsung 9910 Pro SSDが、Gen 5の超高速ストレージを提供し、現在の価格は619.99ドルで413ドルの割引中のWootセールが実施中です。

items.title: Square Enix Keeps Its Forecast Frozen, Yet Final Fantasy VII Revelation Could Still Launch Before March 31, 2027
items.description: Last month, Square Enix confirmed during the annual Summer Game Fest showcase that Final Fantasy VII Revelation will release sometime in Spring 2027 on PC, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch 2. While every fan of the series wishes it would release as soon as possible, Square En
items.tldr: TL;DR: スクウェア・エニックスは、ファイナルファンタジーVIIリヴェレーションが2027年春にPC、PS5、Xbox Series X|S、Nintendo Switch 2向けに発売されると確認したが、予測は変わっていない。

items.title: Intel Core Ultra 270K & 250K Plus CPUs Slide Below MSRP as Gamer Days Bundle Throws in $120 of Tomb Raider and Star Wars Games
items.description: Intel Core Ultra 7 270K Plus & Ultra 5 250K Plus are now available below MSRP and come with a brand new game bundle. Intel Core Ultra 200S Price Drop & New Game Bundle: 270K Plus Now at $290 US, While 250K Plus Starts at $194 Last month, Intel CPUs received a price hike, which was unexpected
items.tldr: Intel Core Ultra 7 270K PlusとUltra 5 250K PlusがMSRPを下回る価格で販売され、$120相当のゲームバンドルが付属しています。

items.title: Apple’s iPhone 18 Pro Margins To Suffer Tremendously As DRAM Estimated To Make Up 42% Of BOM In H1 2027; SoC And OLED Cost Pennies In Comparison
items.description: The iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max launch is just a month away, and with Apple scrambling to get its hands on DRAM supply to complete the A20 Pro packaging, fresh data surrounding the Bill of Materials (BOM) for one variant has some terrible news for consumers. Next year, the 12GB LPD
items.tldr: AppleのiPhone 18 Proは、2027年上半期にDRAMがBOMの42%を占めると予測されており、利益率が大幅に低下する見込みです。SoCやOLEDのコストはそれに比べてわずかです。

items.title: NVIDIA and AMD’s China Market Share to Drop to 10% by 2026 as Domestic Chips Seize 90%, Says Report
items.description: US chip restrictions on China and the Asian nation's focus on local chips are expected to reduce AMD and NVIDIA's market share in the country this year, suggests a fresh report from market research firm TrendForce. Previous reports have suggested that while Chinese firms, such as Huawei, have been u
items.tldr: NVIDIAとAMDの中国市場シェアは、国内チップの台頭により2026年までに10%に減少するとTrendForceの報告が示唆している。

items.title: Member of The Com sent to prison for blackmail, sextortion
items.description: A member of "The Com," a loose-knit online cybercrime collective that targets children and teenagers, has been sentenced to two years in prison for blackmail and sextortion offenses against nearly 120 victims worldwide. [...]
items.tldr: 「The Com」のメンバーが、約120人の被害者に対する脅迫およびセクストーションの罪で2年の懲役刑を言い渡されました。

items.title: New Passkey Attacks Can Recover Synced Private Keys or Bypass Phishing-Resistant MFA
items.description: Three separate research efforts last week demonstrated ways to defeat passkey protections without breaking the cryptography they rest on. Passkeys are designed to replace reusable passwords and resist phishing. The attacks instead reused signed authentication material that Windows had exposed, abuse
items.tldr: TL;DR: 最近の研究により、パスキーの保護を破る新たな攻撃手法が明らかになり、同期されたプライベートキーを回復したり、フィッシング耐性のあるMFAをバイパスすることが可能であることが示された。

items.title: LexisNexis shuts down services after suspicious activity on servers
items.description: LexisNexis took its Diligence, Metabase API, and Newsdesk services offline as part of its response to unusual activity on servers hosted and managed by an unnamed third-party vendor. [...]
items.tldr: LexisNexisは、第三者ベンダーが管理するサーバーでの不審な活動を受けて、Diligence、Metabase API、Newsdeskサービスを一時的に停止しました。

items.title: Shipping 10–50× More Code? Watch This Webinar on Securing AI-Speed Development
items.description: AI is helping development teams produce far more code, far faster. But security teams still have to review vulnerabilities, manage dependencies, prioritize fixes, and control risk at human speed. When software output jumps 10 to 50 times, the problem is no longer just finding vulnerabilities. It is
items.tldr: AIの導入により開発チームはコードを10〜50倍速く生成できるが、セキュリティチームは依然として脆弱性のレビューや依存関係の管理、修正の優先順位付け、リスク管理を人間の速度で行う必要がある。

items.title: Valve notifies Steam hardware customers of a data breach
items.description: Video game publisher and digital distribution giant Valve is notifying Steam hardware customers in Europe that hackers stole their data after hacking its shipping partner, CEVA Logistics. [...]
items.tldr: Valveは、CEVA Logisticsのハッキングにより、Steamハードウェア顧客のデータが盗まれたことを通知しています。

items.title: TrueConf Server Flaws Exploited to Replace Client Installers with PhantomCore
items.description: The threat actor known as Head Mare has been observed weaponizing security flaws in unpatched TrueConf servers once again in attacks targeting Russian companies spanning instrumentation, electronics, transport, energy, IT, and software development sectors. Russian cybersecurity vendor Kaspersky said
items.tldr: ロシアの企業を標的にした攻撃で、Head Mareという脅威アクターが未修正のTrueConfサーバーのセキュリティ脆弱性を悪用し、クライアントインストーラーをPhantomCoreに置き換える事例が報告されている。

items.title: Python Now Has a Post-Quantum Encryption Library
items.description: This is good: Post-quantum cryptography is now one pip-install away for the entire Python ecosystem. With funding from the Sovereign Tech Agency, we implemented support for ML-KEM, the NIST-standard key-establishment primitive, and ML-DSA, the NIST-standard digital-signature primitive, in pyca/crypt
items.tldr: Pythonエコシステムにポスト量子暗号ライブラリが追加され、ML-KEMとML-DSAのサポートがpyca/cryptに実装されました。これにより、ポスト量子暗号が簡単に利用できるようになります。

items.title: Critical Progress LoadMaster flaw now actively exploited in attacks
items.description: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) warned that hackers are exploiting a critical-severity Progress Kemp LoadMaster command injection vulnerability. [...]
items.tldr: CISAは、ハッカーがProgress Kemp LoadMasterのコマンドインジェクション脆弱性を悪用していると警告しています。

items.title: Solidity Pro VS Code Extensions Steal Crypto Wallets, API Keys, and Credentials
items.description: Cybersecurity researchers have flagged a malicious Microsoft Visual Studio Code (VS Code) extension named Solidity Pro ("solidity-pro") that has been observed delivering a browser wallet and credential stealer. The names of the extensions are below - helper-beeps.solidity-pro web3devtoolsx.solidity-
items.tldr: TL;DR: サイバーセキュリティ研究者が、ブラウザウォレットや認証情報を盗む悪意のあるVS Code拡張「Solidity Pro」を警告している。

items.title: OpenAI's Next AI Model Astra Shows Cyber Performance Strong Enough to Trigger Pause
items.description: OpenAI has announced that it's pausing some "internal activities" involving its upcoming artificial intelligence (AI) model Astra after an internal evaluation found it had made significant advancements in agentic coding and cybersecurity. In response to the discovery, the AI upstart said it's implem
items.tldr: OpenAIは、次世代AIモデルAstraがエージェントコーディングとサイバーセキュリティにおいて重要な進展を示したため、一部の「内部活動」を一時停止すると発表しました。

items.title: Hackers breach TrueConf to trojanize client installers with backdoors
items.description: The Head Mare hacktivist group has been exploiting vulnerabilities in unpatched TrueConf video conferencing servers to replace client installers with malicious versions that deliver backdoors. [...]
items.tldr: ハッカー集団Head Mareが、未修正のTrueConfビデオ会議サーバーの脆弱性を悪用し、クライアントインストーラーをバックドアを仕込んだ悪意のあるバージョンに置き換えている。

items.title: Atlassian Rovo Can Be Tricked Into Sending Jira and Confluence Data to Attackers
items.description: Attacker-controlled instructions can make Atlassian's Rovo assistant collect Jira or Confluence data that a signed-in user can access, then send it to an outside server. Two security firms found that behavior independently, by different routes. Only one of those routes is confirmed closed. PromptArm
items.tldr: AtlassianのRovoアシスタントは、攻撃者が制御する指示によってJiraやConfluenceのデータを収集し、外部サーバーに送信するように騙される可能性があることが、2つのセキュリティ企業によって独立して発見されました。

items.title: New CSS Attacks Can Break Webmail Defenses to Steal Passwords and Tokens
items.description: New research shows content inside an email can escape its message boundary and interfere with the webmail interface. Across attack chains spanning Outlook, Gmail, Fastmail, Proton Mail, Yahoo Mail, and AOL Mail, the techniques can capture passwords, take over third-party accounts, leak tokens, hijac
items.tldr: 新たなCSS攻撃がウェブメールの防御を突破し、OutlookやGmailなどのサービスでパスワードやトークンを盗む手法が明らかになった。

items.title: Metabase Zero-Day Exploited in Wild Allows Admin Access Without Authentication
items.description: Metabase has warned that a maximum-severity security flaw impacting its business intelligence and data visualization software package has been exploited in the wild as a zero-day. The vulnerability (CVSS score: 10.0), which does not carry a CVE identifier, allows an unauthenticated remote attacker t
items.tldr: Metabaseのビジネスインテリジェンスソフトウェアに深刻なゼロデイ脆弱性が発見され、認証なしで管理者アクセスが可能となっており、既に悪用されていると警告しています。

items.title: N-able Issues N-central Hotfix 2 as Attackers Reach Managed Systems and Persist
items.description: N-able has released a fresh round of hotfixes for N‑central as part of its investigation into ongoing exploitation of a recently disclosed security flaw in the Remote Monitoring and Management (RMM) product. "We are proactively expanding protections in response to ongoing monitoring of threat actors
items.tldr: N-ableは、Remote Monitoring and Management (RMM)製品の最近発表されたセキュリティ脆弱性の悪用に対処するため、N-centralのホットフィックス2をリリースしました。攻撃者の活動を監視し、保護を強化するための措置です。

items.title: Progress Kemp LoadMaster Flaw Hits CISA KEV After 792 Reported Exploit Attempts
items.description: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) on Friday added a critical-severity security flaw impacting Progress Kemp LoadMaster to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, following reports of active exploitation in the wild. The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-803
items.tldr: Progress Kemp LoadMasterの深刻なセキュリティ脆弱性（CVE-2026-803）が、CISAの既知の悪用脆弱性リストに追加され、792件の悪用試行が報告された。

items.title: Friday Squid Blogging: Arctic Bobtail Squid Video
items.description: Nice video of the Arctic bobtail squid. As usual, you can also use this squid post to talk about the security stories in the news that I haven’t covered. Blog moderation policy.
items.tldr: アークティックボブテイルイカの魅力的な動画が紹介されており、同時に未報道のセキュリティ関連ニュースについても議論できる場が提供されています。

items.title: Metabase SQLi zero-day exploited in customer data-theft attacks
items.description: A critical Metabase SQL injection vulnerability was exploited in zero-day attacks to breach customer instances in data theft attacks, known to impact Framework and Tally. [...]
items.tldr: MetabaseのSQLインジェクションの重大な脆弱性がゼロデイ攻撃に悪用され、FrameworkやTallyに影響を与える顧客データ盗難攻撃が発生しました。

items.title: Unlimited Technology Systems breach impacts 3.8 million people
items.description: Healthcare software company Unlimited Technology Systems reported that more than 3.8 million people were impacted by a data breach incident that occurred in October 2025. [...]
items.tldr: Unlimited Technology Systemsは、2025年10月に発生したデータ侵害により、380万人以上が影響を受けたと報告しています。

items.title: Zbtlink製ルータに出荷時組み込まれていたバックドアについてまとめてみた
items.description: 2026年8月5日、米国セキュリティ企業のVulnCheckは、中国Zbtlink製ルータの出荷時ファームウェアに遠隔操作用のインプラント「ENDLESSDOORS」が組み込まれていたとする調査結果を公開しました。対象の実装は外部から侵害を受けて仕込まれたものではなく、出荷された時点からベンダ自身によって組み込まれていたとされています。Zbtlinkはこの指摘に対し独自の説明を示しており、VulnCheckの観測と正面から対立しています。ここでは関連する情報をまとめます。 どんな脆弱性が確認されたの? ZbtlinkはShenzhen Zhibotong Electronicsのブランドで、ル
items.tldr: 米国のセキュリティ企業VulnCheckが、中国Zbtlink製ルータの出荷時ファームウェアにバックドア「ENDLESSDOORS」が組み込まれていたと報告し、Zbtlinkはこれに対して反論しています。
